sloka: रामस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा तथा चक्रे स सारथिः ।प्रत्यागम्य च रामस्य स्यन्दनम् प्रत्यवेदयत् ॥२-४६-३२॥
transliteration: rāmasya vacanam śrutvā tathā cakre sa sārathiḥ ।pratyāgamya ca rāmasya syandanam pratyavedayat ॥2-46-32॥

translations.english: The charioteer did as instructed by Rama, returned to him with the chariot and informed (of its readiness).
